metadata.methods_description: Pink noise bursts were presented from loudspeakers at several elevations and 10° azimuth in a hemi-anechoic chamber. Experiment I (subjects 001-023) used a long adapter noise followed by a short probe burst from another elevation, with button-press responses to deviants. Experiment II (subjects 100-134) used a long white noise adapter over open headphones followed by a burst from one of four elevations. About 5% of trials were targets that prompted localization of the previous sound. Subjects 130-134 completed a second session with molds inserted to disrupt elevation perception.
